visitorLane.strategy: Post-reconciliation expansion is utility-led, not count-led. Protect the 751 healthy searchable-place baseline while improving first-impression live quality, provider/geographic diversity, destination depth, related-place journeys and repeated genuine demand gaps. Add new places only when they independently improve visitor value.
visitorLane.researchBacklogPolicy: Research may continue autonomously, but public promotion remains fail-closed and no catalog-count milestone may drive promotion.

centralAsia.rule: Owner approved deferring Pamir. Revisit later with quasi-live/current-image sources if quality improves; Pamir does not block other regions.

worldGapFamilies: Pamir core — still unresolved; no weak substitute
Antarctica — Australian Antarctic Program current-image stations
Panama Canal — official real-time lock cameras
Costa Rica — OVSICORI volcano current-image family
Nicaragua — INETER real-time volcano image family
KenyaLIVE — KWS daily wildlife live program

acceptedEvidence: provider-published current image with reliable timestamp
quasiLivePolicy.rule: Quasi-live/current-image sources are identified by LIVE_IMAGE truth and UI copy; redundant per-record category tags are intentionally avoided to preserve the production size budget.

progressToTarget.rule: No new numeric place-count target. Expansion is judged by visitor utility, source quality, geographic/provider diversity, repeat exploration and truthful planning paths.

visitorLane.catalogScaleStrategy: Core data/sources.json remains below the strict 300 KB ceiling. New scale uses a separately deployed, lazy-on-search supplemental catalog; do not raise the core ceiling.
currentPriorityGaps: Watch Earth first-30-seconds source-backed visual quality
Underrepresented geography/provider families where a genuinely strong current source exists
Current playback proof renewal for benchmark/high-value live destinations

searchSupplementalCatalog.rule: Supplemental records are part of unified public discovery. They must not be treated as a hidden search-only side catalog, and coordinates must never be fabricated.

businessLane.verifiedOfferStrategy: Prefer destination-level links and one useful commercial action per intent; no commission ranking.
businessLane.accommodationRule: Research-only until owner-project availability is confirmed.
businessLane.quasiLiveCommercialRule: A healthy quasi-live searchable place may unlock downstream travel planning, but commercial value never changes truth/currentness.
businessLane.priorityRule: Prefer exact destination/product fit inside existing active partners before broad generic destination links. Batch owner link generation rather than interrupting one destination at a time.
businessLane.tripComReason: Owner screenshots confirm Trip.com is visible in Travelpayouts but not yet unlocked for ERN. Keep it P1 future stay/transport coverage and recheck only after material traffic/account-state change.
businessLane.unlockRule: Locked Travelpayouts programs are traffic-led future targets; do not repeatedly recheck. Use active partners and currently link-generation-capable utilities first.
businessLane.etoshaNote: Official Namibia Wildlife Resorts evidence supports an Okaukuejo live-camera candidate, but ERN keeps it research-only until exact target playback is human-confirmed.

currentNowStrategy.primary: Use existing verified destination-level offers and utilities only after Earth discovery, prioritizing places with demonstrated visitor intent.
currentNowStrategy.secondary: Convert high-fit existing-partner opportunities in batches where the visitor need is clear; do not increase button density for its own sake.
currentNowStrategy.traffic: Increase qualified organic discovery, repeat exploration, deep-link sharing and planning intent before chasing traffic-gated partner programs.
currentNowStrategy.avoid: No paid ranking, no automatic link rewriting, no owner interruption for speculative one-off links, and no return to offer-count or catalog-count expansion.

businessLane.tripComRule: Do not open a separate direct account or repeatedly recheck Travelpayouts. Revisit only on meaningful traffic/conversion growth or explicit unlock.
businessLane.rule: Expand business utility only where it follows real destination interest and verified coverage. Traffic and commission signals never change source truth, currentness or editorial prominence.

safeguards.productionCompletionRule: Visitor-facing expansion is complete only after matching successful Pages + Operations on the same content SHA and post-deploy production verification.
